task: Read-only next-stage native audit of general callback overlap/reentry
conclusion: A counted per-actor nested original-only lane is a concrete bounded fidelity improvement for six argument-classified callbacks: null-subkey registry open A/W, null-application process A/W, and exact folder-id!=5 folder A/W. It can overlap one ordinary general body without accessing or sharing fabricated-handle membership. Close/query and nonnull/matching general paths remain outside this lane.

native_observations.subject: RegOpenKeyExA/W
native_observations.claim: Native unconditionally calls original first atf823/f983. It then compares input subkey with configured ClientKey/ClientKey2 and optionally LanguageKey; matches fabricate on original error and insert the returned handle. Null input makes each86b0/87f0 comparison return1 before value resolution or CRT comparison. Local key names are SSO strings(length9/10/11,capacity15);00aa50 cleanup takes no free branch for these. Null-subkey execution still reads language-enabled bytea3ad1 atf8b7/fa17, but cannot match or write any shared set. The proposed direct source shortcut omits this inert config read and local SSO bookkeeping while preserving original call/result/output.

native_observations.subject: null comparison branch
native_observations.claim: 86b0 TEST RCX at86d7; null calls SSO cleanup86df, produces1 at86e4, jumps over value resolver and_stricmp.87f0 TEST at8817; null cleanup881f, produces1 at8824, jumps over resolver and_wcsicmp. No original DLL CRT compare/map/encoding/PTD access is needed for these caller-specific null paths.

native_observations.subject: CreateProcessA/W
native_observations.claim: Native compares application name to configured ClientPath before original. Equality suppresses original with zero result. Null application follows the pure null comparison above and dispatches original atf4ac/f58c. Command line and all other pointers/scalars are forwarded untouched; no need to inspect command line to classify. Nonnull application, including empty string, is not argument-only: missing configured ClientPath can resolve to empty, and comparison uses maps/conversion/CRT.

native_observations.subject: SHGetFolderPathA/W
native_observations.claim: Helpers compare folder id exactly with5 at8dfb/8feb and branch around value lookup/copy for every other integer. Thus id!=5 forwards original without reading/writing caller output in the reconstructed body. Do not mask CSIDL flag bits or broaden id5 using an empty path guess; native compares the complete supplied integer.

native_observations.subject: RegCloseKey
native_observations.claim: Always searches fabricated seta3800 before dispatching original atf6bb. Fabricated path erases entry,frees4-byte token,logs. Original failure returns immediately, but only after membership test; success erases client/language sets. No argument-only native close classification was established. Ordinary-looking or OS-like handle values cannot be assumed absent from tracked/fabricated sets.

native_observations.subject: RegQueryValueExA/W
native_observations.claim: Captures caller capacity if nonnull, invokes original, then helper always searches client/language sets and eventually fabricated set when no replacement. Null value name prevents string matches but does not prevent set access or fabricated-handle fallback(log+error2). Null output pointers and original failure do not prove pure forwarding.

native_observations.subject: reentry evidence boundary
native_observations.claim: Examined native hook instructions contain ordinary original calls plus their native processing, with no source-style Domain admission rejection. This does not establish that any Windows implementation calls another hooked API, that recursion actually occurs, or that arbitrary full-body concurrency/reentry is safe.

source_observations.claim: Native Context Lease already counts concurrent/nested wrapper invocations and retains Context through admission leave. Only connect uses invoke_selected direct-original selection; all other wrappers enter ordinary admission before their callback logic, including the pure predicates above.

One thread-local OriginalConnectLane cannot represent nested callbacks. connect try_enter rejects any existing actor lane or same-thread general active reservation. Ordinary enter rejects actor lane and any active general body. leave identifies only connect lane or one globally stored general callback; it needs an exact frame/token for nested direct calls.

CallbackThreads has one active thread/fiber/PTD scope, rejects second enter, and makes nested permission-probe checking sticky poison. A direct original-only nested lane must not call CallbackThreads enter/leave or perform general permission probes. Outer ordinary owner retains and later validates its own actual FLS/PTD identity.

OriginalEffects preserves SDK typing and raw caller storage, verifies permission before virtual provider resolution and again around actual SDK invocation, validates exact slots, and retains provider/code owner. Publication load uses short metadata lock and sealed successful-create receipt per hook. These existing objects can serve the narrow lane; no new untyped raw trampoline bypass is warranted.

Source short circuits agree with native null/id predicates. Other open/process predicates may resolve values/conversion/CRT. General CRT and encoding are guarded by callback_scope; nested direct scope must mask that permission so it cannot inherit a Full outer callback's general access.

proposed_plan.action: Add an explicit callback selection descriptor for pure-original predicates before ordinary admission under existing native Context lease. Select RegOpenA/W only on subkey==nullptr, ProcessA/W only application==nullptr, FolderA/W only exact id!=5. Fall back unchanged for every other general path. Connect retains its observed wait/redirect decisions.

Generalize counted Original-only metadata into per-actor stack-linked frames retained on native wrapper/SDK-call stack. Each frame stores Domain owner, exact callback/token, same thread/fiber, parent pointer, and phase. Check target hook successful-create publication; restore exact parent on normal/exceptional leave and preserve WinLastError bookkeeping. Root frames contribute to existing admission drain count. Automatic frames avoid synthetic private PTD/allocation.

For the first bounded nested profile, accept nested pure-forward entries during an admitted actual Original SDK invocation. Mark SDK invocation after provider resolution/checkpoint, and clear it before returning to caller checks. Keep provider-resolution/checking, recovered CRT/encoding, managed stream callbacks, waits, redirect effects and non-pure general bodies outside nested permission. This phase restriction is a deliberate source policy, not an observed native gate.

Topmost original-only frame grants only original_scope. Deny callback_scope, connect_wait_scope and connect_body_scope while it is current, even if parent is Full/Waiting/Redirect. Do not acquire CallbackThreads or inspect registry/map/handle state. Pop restores outer scope and its existing postchecks, including actual PTD validation for an outer general body.

Dispatch selected paths only through existing typed OriginalEffects methods and publication provider. Forward all caller arguments/output cells and exact lower return bits; preserve lower exception/postcheck behavior. Existing binding count covers every native callback, including nested entries. Do not synthesize Win32 results.
Keep close/query/non-null open/process/id5 folder bodies exclusive with their existing map/fabricated-handle ownership; no fake-handle snapshot or unsynchronized membership test in direct selector.

Later validation should use source-level injected SDK fixtures to exercise nested pure-original calls, scope masking, restored outer reservation/FLS, exact argument/result forwarding, failed publication, denial of close/query/matching bodies, multiple actors, and balanced counts on exceptions. No fixture was compiled/run in this audit. Such synthetic reentry verifies the new source policy only; it cannot demonstrate Windows itself reenters hooks.

limitations: All behavioral claims are static shipped-artifact observations or explicitly labeled source design inferences. No original or rebuilt DLL was executed.
Complete Evidence25 records retains every native body and all Ghidra limitations. Pseudocode return typing is heuristic; SDK signatures come from existing typed source and instruction sites.
No blanket general callback, shared fabricated-handle, CRT/PTD, or arbitrary Windows internal reentry support is claimed.
Source hashes identify this audit's inspected redirect-stage snapshot; future edits must be distinguished from these hashes.
No new unload protocol or speculative Windows requirement is proposed; existing task constraints and admission lifetime ownership remain.
